fix_instructions: To make the scenario solvable only via multi-agent communication, ensure that the shared public facts (S1, S2, S3, S4) are insufficient to trigger C1, C3, C4, or C5. Specifically, the public facts must not contain the 2.4% solvent level (PF1), the 8-drum limit (PF2), or the 4-drum seep count (PF3).
